comment: One-sided exploratory gates. Each limit is the maximum eligible official per-capture quantile plus spreadAllowance times the observed max-minus-min spread. Zero allowance uses the complete observed envelope without tuning against a local host. At least 100 samples per metric avoids calibrating on smoke captures. Lower correction, delay and frame gaps are permitted. This is not a confidence interval or a claim of renderer equivalence.

anchor_receipt_p50.comment: Typical stock-client interpolation reset correction, in world units. Includes network and collector timing. Use every eligible capture in the chosen reference corpus; the default pins clean near-server development batches.

anchor_receipt_p95.comment: Tail correction magnitude; the observed official envelope is the initial tolerance. Correlated anchor windows are not independent trials.

frame_server_p50.comment: Median elapsed-ms header interval. Detects delayed server batching independently of receipt jitter; sparse official captures widen this envelope.

delay_p90.comment: Receipt-minus-server excess over a centered +/-600-frame minimum. The default reference filters whole intervals with the frozen near-server telemetry mask; the retained home reference includes collector stalls. No absolute latency inference.
